posts.text: It's obviously a big deal, and we should all be aghast, but I really can't get over this whole framing that Trump is going to "declare" two elected senators illegitimate. That has about as much weight as me declaring myself king of the realm. Just actual parody at this point.

posts.text: Darline seems like a nice woman. She's a mom, works with people with disabilities helping them find jobs, having a normal reaction to her brother's death. Under no circumstances she should be a sitting member of the U.S. Senate for four months. Especially in wartime.
